content.user_title: Assess Data Insurance Risks and Coverage
content.value_statement: Organizations often lack a structured way to match data risks with suitable insurance coverage. This skill produces practical assessments, coverage plans, exclusion reviews, and claims checklists.
actual_capabilities: Identifies data leakage, alteration, loss, infringement, and service error risks.
Maps assessed risks to cyber, data-loss, E&O, and intellectual property insurance.
Suggests methods for estimating coverage limits, deductibles, and policy periods.
Reviews exclusions and highlights scenarios that may not be covered.
Prepares structured materials for broker discussions, underwriting, claims, and annual reviews.
Drafts insurance coverage disclosures for financing and data transactions.
limitations: It does not issue policies, bind coverage, or guarantee an insurer will accept a risk.
It cannot replace legal, regulatory, tax, actuarial, or licensed insurance advice.
Premiums, policy terms, and product availability require current quotations from insurers or brokers.
Recommendations depend on accurate asset, security, incident, and policy information supplied by the user.

use_cases.title: Evaluate data asset risks
use_cases.description: Create an insurable risk register for data assets before requesting broker quotations.

use_cases.title: Compare policy coverage
use_cases.description: Compare proposed policies by coverage limits, deductibles, exclusions, waiting periods, and disclosure duties.

use_cases.title: Prepare financing disclosure
use_cases.description: Explain insurance coverage and remaining risks to lenders or transaction partners without presenting insurance as a guarantee.

prompt_templates.title: Identify basic data risks
prompt_templates.prompt: List the insurable risks for [data asset]. Cover leakage, alteration, loss, infringement, and service errors. State what information is missing.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs an initial risk inventory.

prompt_templates.title: Design a coverage mix
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an insurance mix for [organization]. Compare cyber, data-loss, E&O, and intellectual property coverage. Explain suggested limits and deductibles.
prompt_templates.scenario: A risk manager is preparing for broker discussions.

prompt_templates.title: Review policy exclusions
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these policy terms: [terms]. Create a plain-language exclusion table. Identify coverage gaps, disclosure duties, waiting periods, and questions for the broker.
prompt_templates.scenario: A procurement team is comparing policy wording.

prompt_templates.title: Build a claims and financing package
prompt_templates.prompt: Using [incident facts] and [policy terms], prepare a claims evidence checklist and financing disclosure. Separate covered, uncertain, excluded, and uninsured losses.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user needs coordinated claims and stakeholder materials.

output_examples.input: Assess insurance needs for a customer analytics dataset containing personal information.
output_examples.output: Primary risks include unauthorized disclosure, service interruption, regulatory response costs, and third-party claims. Consider cyber and E&O coverage, then verify privacy exclusions.

output_examples.input: Compare two policies when one has a lower premium but excludes known vulnerabilities.
output_examples.output: The lower premium may create a material coverage gap. Compare remediation requirements, vulnerability definitions, reporting deadlines, limits, deductibles, and the cost of retained risk.

output_examples.input: Prepare an insurance disclosure for a lender reviewing a data-backed financing request.
output_examples.output: State the insurer, policy period, limits, deductibles, and major exclusions. Explain that coverage reduces financial risk but does not guarantee asset value or financing approval.

best_practices: Provide current asset values, data classifications, security controls, incident history, and complete policy wording.
Request plain-language explanations for every exclusion, condition, sublimit, waiting period, and reporting deadline.
Validate recommendations with licensed brokers, insurers, and legal advisers before making coverage or claims decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not select a policy using premium alone while ignoring exclusions and coverage limits.
Do not conceal incidents, vulnerabilities, or material risk facts during underwriting.
Do not describe insurance as legal immunity, an asset guarantee, or assurance of financing approval.

faq.question: What types of insurance does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers cyber, data asset loss, E&O, and intellectual property or infringement liability insurance.

faq.question: Can it calculate an exact premium?
faq.answer: No. It can explain pricing factors, but exact premiums require current quotations from insurers or brokers.

faq.question: Can it confirm that a claim will be paid?
faq.answer: No. Payment depends on policy wording, facts, evidence, exclusions, reporting duties, and the insurer's decision.

faq.question: Does insurance remove compliance obligations?
faq.answer: No. Insurance transfers some financial risk but does not remove security, privacy, contractual, or legal obligations.

faq.question: What information improves the assessment?
faq.answer: Provide data categories, asset values, processing activities, security controls, incidents, contracts, and complete proposed policy terms.

faq.question: Can insurance support financing or a transaction?
faq.answer: Yes. Coverage can reduce perceived risk, but it does not guarantee asset value, transaction completion, or financing approval.
